additional_info.subject: RE: ID0478502-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2 / S1 313508370035] Log check for 0 recharges CRM:00263000457
additional_info.body:
Dear Maria,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0478502
for charger
Y2/S1 313508370035.
The ticket was opened to analyze failed sessions on charger
Y2/S1 313508370035
on 2026.02.14.
I analyzed the logs, and there was a wrong configuration in the outlet settings of the outlet, so that outlet 1 was correctly configured but referring to the SECC dealing with outlet 2, and viceversa.
I corrected this wrong configuration already.
Since the issue is solved and the analysis provided, I will close this ticket.
With kind regards,
